rule: เนื้อ's eleven senses are one substance read at four depths, and the compound's OBJECT says which. Sense 1, the flesh under the skin, takes the anatomy — กล้ามเนื้อ, เนื้อเยื่อ, เนื้องอก — and with it the three compounds where a person's own flesh STANDS FOR the person: เนื้อหนัง, the body and its appetites against the spirit; เลือดเนื้อ, blood and flesh, meaning one's own child; and เนื้อคู่, the flesh that matches yours from a former life. Sense 2 is flesh as FOOD — its via_note separates the specialisation from the beef default, and เนื้อสัตว์ exists precisely to override that default, so it files there, as does ขนงเนื้อ, the scorched and simmered hide of the beast. Sense 3, the stuff a thing is characteristically made of, takes the two compounds that ask what something really consists of: เนื้อผ้า, the fabric of the matter and so the truth of it, and เนื้อที่, the substance of a place and so its area. Sense 6, the gist, keeps the content words beside เนื้อหา and เนื้อเรื่อง, which sources filed: เนื้อความ, the text of a message, and เนื้อร้อง, the words written to be sung. Sense 9, capital and means, takes its first compound in ควักเนื้อ — to gouge out your own flesh is to pay from your own pocket. Sense 11 takes เนื้อทราย, the hog deer that its own via_note names. Senses 4, 5, 7, 8 and 10 take nothing here.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**ควักเนื้อ gives sense 9 its first compound.** Sense 9 is ทุนเดิม, เงิน, ทรัพย์ —
capital, money, means, three metonymies down the chain from the gold-content sense
— and it had stood empty. ควักเนื้อ is เสียเงินส่วนตัว, to pay out of your own
pocket: literally to gouge out your own flesh. The sense was waiting for it.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**เนื้อสัตว์ at 2, decided by the via_note and not by the gloss.** Sense 2 reads
เนื้อวัวหรือเนื้อควาย — beef or buffalo — which on its face excludes a word meaning
meat in general. The EXTENDS note separates the two things the sense is doing:
*flesh as food, and by default beef or buffalo*. เนื้อสัตว์ is flesh as food, built
expressly to override the beef default. Filed on the specialisation, not on the
default.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**ขนงเนื้อ at 2, with a part I cannot account for.** The dish is หนังสัตว์ที่เผาไฟ
ให้สุกแล้วต้มให้เปื่อย — hide scorched and simmered soft. The เนื้อ is the beast it
came off, so sense 2. But **ขนง is glossed only คิ้ว (eyebrow) and a basketry
form**, neither of which is hide; RID adds บางทีเรียกว่า ขนอง, and ขนอง is the
back. The compound has no etymology and the `lit_th` the enricher built for it
reads "คิ้ว + flesh", which is wrong on the first part. The head is not in doubt;
the modifier is. Not fixed here.
